integrity: Analytic proof gives the all-size number of closed communicating classes and the complete random-type fragmentation distribution, including exact consensus probability, sparse-type limit, and tied-weight boundary. The checker independently verifies full distributions and influence-graph closed classes on finite rings; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A nearest-neighbor cycle, strictly positive two-neighbor weights, fixed adjustment fractions in (0,1), closest-point median tie rule, and independent one-time node type labels. Not an assertion about arbitrary topologies or random initial-condition success probabilities. The exactly balanced half-weight model is a distinct boundary case. Closed classes refer to independent asymptotic degrees of freedom, not distinct opinions for every initial vector.
title: Exact consensus reliability from directional runs in mixed-median opinion rings
